title: Meet Dana
body: Dana manages prior auth for a 6-provider orthopedic practice. Here's her morning before and after this tool.

title: Every case, one view
body: All open and recent prior auth cases across every payer, with days remaining on each SLA.

title: Full case history
body: Every submission, call, and document for a case, in one timeline.

title: A denial, caught immediately
body: This case was denied for a missing clinical note. The system flagged it the moment the payer responded, not days later.

title: The clock is visible
body: A live countdown to the appeal deadline. No more guessing from memory.

title: Dana still decides
body: Nothing goes back to the payer until Dana reviews it and clicks submit herself.

title: The numbers that matter
body: Open cases, average decision time, denial rate, and appeals won — all computed from real case data.

title: How this would be built
body: This concept maps to the practice's existing tools: Epic for records, Availity and payer portals for submission, with human approval before every payer-facing action.
